description: Calculates how many impressions a click target needs at a CTR you choose (clicks ÷ CTR). Use it to size a goal; project_clicks_at_ctr goes the other way. The result is a modelled value. With a CTR of 0 there is no answer, and the result gives the reason instead of a number.

clicks.description: The click target, a whole number.

ctrPercent.description: CTR as a percentage from 0 to 100: 3 means 3%, 0.5 means 0.5%. Not a fraction.

name: impressions_needed_for_clicks

evidence.description: observed, calculated (exact arithmetic), modelled (depends on an assumed CTR) or not_established.

nullReason.description: Why value is null; null when there is a value.

unit.description: ctr_fraction (0.045 = 4.5%), percentage_points, percent, clicks or impressions.

value.description: The unrounded value, or null when it is undefined or withheld.

title: Impressions needed for a click target
